description: This header file defines the interface for managing a set of cameraDevice objects, including creation, deletion, searching, iteration, and transfer of camera devices within a set.

methods.name: createCameraSet
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new camera set.

methods.name: destroyCameraSet
methods.description: Destroys a camera set and its contained cameraDevice objects.

methods.name: clearCameraSet
methods.description: Removes all cameraDevice objects from a camera set without destroying the set itself.

methods.name: appendCameraToSet
methods.description: Adds a cameraDevice object to the set, with locking.

methods.name: cameraSetIterate
methods.description: Applies a callback function to each cameraDevice in the set.

methods.name: findCameraByUuid
methods.description: Searches for a cameraDevice in the set using its UUID.

methods.name: findCameraByIpAddress
methods.description: Searches for a cameraDevice in the set using its IP address.

methods.name: destroyCameraDeviceFromSet
methods.description: Removes and destroys a cameraDevice from the set by UUID.

methods.name: moveCameraDeviceToSet
methods.description: Transfers a cameraDevice identified by UUID from one set to another.

methods.name: cameraSetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of cameraDevice objects in the set.
